resources.string: Connect a device to get started.
Bluetooth permission is required to scan and connect to tags.

Tag needs Bluetooth to find and connect to your sensor tag.

On Android 11 and below, Location is also required for BLE scanning (the app does not track your location).

CSV files are saved with the system file picker — no broad storage access on modern Android.
Turn on Bluetooth to scan for tags.
Scanning for Tag devices…\n\nMake sure the tag is powered on and nearby.
